what_this_is: Which kernel court decides a Grand Map requirement. The map's own evidence_ref points at a FILE in the superseded app, and a file is not proof: 159 of 187 refs aim at 12.PRODUCTION. A requirement bound here is judged by a kernel test instead. Anything unbound stays NOT JUDGED - that is the honest default, and it is what SPEC 12 calls the superseding court.

rules.PASS: every bound test ran and passed, and at least one matched
rules.FAIL: any bound test failed or errored
rules.NOT JUDGED: no binding declared, or no bound test in the report

brain_context_recall.why: what is in focus and what is owed survive and are recalled

brain_diligence.why: an obligation cannot be closed by claiming it, only by meeting it

selfext_settle.why: a verdict settles work that the graph owns, not a claim

selfext_lens_artifact.why: the artifact itself is verified, not its description

selfext_lens_diligence.why: shortcuts are refused by the value graph, not by good intentions

selfext_lens_independence.why: the witness is external to the thing it witnesses

selfext_court_signal.why: a verdict emits a fact other parts of the graph can react to

website_page_renderer.why: the site is projected from the graph, not authored beside it

website_content_source.why: page content comes from graph facts

website_build_info.why: what shipped is stamped from the exact revision

connectors_broker.why: an adapter is reached through one brokered seam, not ad hoc

connectors_registry.why: the roster of adapters is graph-held and admitted

connectors_approval_gate.why: a write through an adapter passes an approval gate first

nl_conn_effect_primitives.why: an adapter call is an effectful primitive the graph governs

nl_arch_group_runs.why: a group of nodes runs as one node, and opens back into its members

nl_arch_incremental.why: only what changed recomputes, and the result equals a full recompute

brain_skills.why: a skill is graph-held, names the work it was learned from, and cannot be promoted without evidence

brain_secrets.why: the graph holds only where a secret lives and who has custody; a value-looking reference is refused and resolution writes nothing back

brain_reflexion.why: a failure closes only when a root cause AND a control are named; the same signature again is a recurrence that names the control which failed

brain_embeddings.why: embeddings are graph facts carrying their model and exact dimension; a mismatched vector is refused, recall never mixes models, and deleting the index forgets

brain_owner_binding.why: exactly one owner per root, no default owner, and a transfer only with consent naming both this owner and this subject

brain_explorer.why: folders are derived from the facts that exist, never stored; a folder holding nothing does not exist

brain_personal_cloud_sync.why: the merge law: later clock wins, ties break on origin not arrival, every arrival order reaches the same brain, and replaying a batch changes nothing

brain_firm_federation.why: only the owner may share a fact, only to a named firm, and only a redaction crosses

community_tier_gate.why: what crosses is a redaction the owner chose; someone outside the firm sees nothing

brain_community.why: incoming from a peer is quarantined on arrival and invisible until judged

community_quarantine.why: nothing merges on arrival; quarantine holds it with its provenance

community_subscribe.why: subscribing is agreeing to hear, not to believe; an unsubscribed peer is refused

community_incoming_eval.why: a judgement admits or rejects, once, and a rejection is kept so the same claim is not argued twice

community_create_group.why: a group has exactly one owner and the owner is already a member

community_join_code.why: the graph keeps only a fingerprint of a join code, never the code; only the owner issues, a code opens one group, and it cannot be spent twice

community_fanout_export.why: export can only see what the owner already shared, and only redactions cross

community_fanout_apply.why: apply never writes a fact; every incoming card lands in quarantine to be judged

community_firm_outbox.why: the outbox is derived from shares, never queued, so nothing sits in it the owner did not share

community_share_card.why: a shared card is the owner's redaction bound to one firm

community_redaction_promote.why: only the redaction is promoted outward; the raw fact never leaves

community_poller.why: taking a peer's cards is the same quarantine path as any other incoming

models_keys.why: a provider points at a secret-vault entry, never a key; a provider whose key was never put in custody cannot be registered

models_blocklist.why: every failure kind is classified and sets a cooldown the graph holds; a cooling provider must not be called

models_usage.why: every call is metered with a whole token count; a call that reports no real count is refused

models_claude.why: Claude is an admitted provider registered by reference

models_openai.why: GPT is an admitted provider registered by reference

models_gemini.why: Gemini is an admitted provider registered by reference

models_local.why: a local model is an admitted provider registered by reference

models_cli_sub.why: a signed-in CLI subscription is an admitted provider registered by reference

selfext_intent_ask.why: an ask is recorded and grants nothing by itself

selfext_agency_gate.why: only the asker may grant scope, and an intent with no granted scope cannot become work at all

selfext_atomize.why: work outside the granted scope is refused, not warned about

selfext_req_tree.why: the leaves inside the granted scope are the requirement tree

selfext_library_first.why: nothing is built until the library was actually searched, and the search must name what it searched

users_firm.why: a firm has one owner, buys seats up front, and the owner holds the first

users_seats.why: seats are counted before they are given; a firm cannot be invited into beyond its seats

users_invite.why: only the owner invites, the token is kept as a fingerprint and never appears in the graph

users_invite_accept.why: the invite is bound to the address it was sent to, so a forwarded token opens nothing, and it cannot be accepted twice

users_owner_transfer.why: ownership moves only with consent naming both the current owner and the subject

sessions_param_pool.why: the parameter pool holds and replaces by name; a nameless parameter is refused

sessions_chain_state.why: draft to active to closed and no other way; a closed session accepts nothing more

sessions_autosave.why: the debounce is a fact about the payload, not a timer: saving the same thing twice does not move the revision

sessions_save_guard.why: a save is read back out of the graph and compared before it is accepted

sessions_pin.why: a session can be pinned once

sessions_replay.why: replay is every save in order; the session is its own history

ui_voice_lint.why: the voice rules refuse out-of-voice text at the moment it is written, not in review

website_voice_lint.why: no emoji, no exclamation, no overclaim, and glyphs normalised, enforced by a kernel court

website_seo_meta.why: title, description and canonical come out of the graph; no origin means no canonical link, and out-of-voice text is refused

website_changelog_parser.why: the changelog holds only released revisions; a draft is not a public claim and a summary is required

website_download_cta.why: a download is offered only for a revision the changelog calls released, and only for an artifact the graph holds

brain_daemon.why: the capabilities the brain offers are installed into the same graph the running application serves, and a court builds the real application and asserts it can reach every one
